name: image-to-code
title_zh: 先画设计图再照着写页面的 Codex 建站技能
tagline_zh: 视觉要求高的页面，它不急着写代码：先自己生成大图、逐块读图，再一比一还原成网页。适合对成品长相有预期。
tagline_en: For visually demanding pages it generates large section images first, reads them closely, then builds the site to.
desc_en: Elite website image-to-code skill for Codex. For visually important web tasks, it must first generate the design image(s) itself, deeply analyze them, then implement the website to match them as closely as possible. In Codex, it must prefer large, readable, section-specific images instead of tiny compressed boards, generate fresh standalone images for sections or detail views instead of cropping o
why_zh: 拒绝压缩成一张小拼图，坚持每个区块单独出大图、单独分析，细节视图也重新生成而不是裁切。
why_en: It refuses tiny compressed boards: each section gets its own large image and its own analysis, and detail views are regenerated.
limit_zh: 只在 Codex 里跑，且必须能调图像生成；纯文本模型或禁用出图的环境直接失效。它只保证「像那张图」。
limit_en: Codex-only and needs image generation available; text-only or image-disabled setups fail outright. It only matches the image it made — aesthetics.
title_en: Codex skill that draws the design first, then codes to it
